about: Ofloxacin 200 mg tablets (no Australian brand, so the ingredient name is used) are supplied in April and August 2026 to a 72-year-old woman.
Two courses of ofloxacin 200 mg tablets are supplied in January and February 2026, in the middle of a 16-month history of a 69-year-old woman.
Only ofloxacin 0.3% eye drops and a short course of trimethoprim tablets are supplied. Eye drops are not a supply by mouth or injection, so the criterion is not met.
